definitions.explanation: a line segment connecting two non-adjacent vertices of a polygon

examples.japanese: {正方形|せいほうけい}の{対角線|たいかくせん}を{引|ひ}く。
examples.english: To draw the diagonal of a square.

examples.japanese: {長方形|ちょうほうけい}の{対角線|たいかくせん}の{長|なが}さを{計算|けいさん}する。
examples.english: To calculate the length of the diagonal of a rectangle.

examples.japanese: {六角形|ろっかくけい}には{九本|きゅうほん}の{対角線|たいかくせん}がある。

notes:
GEOMETRY:
The number of diagonals in a polygon with n sides is n(n-3)/2.

RELATED TERMS:
- {斜線|しゃせん} (diagonal/slanted line in general)
- {対角|たいかく} (diagonal; opposite corners)
- {頂点|ちょうてん} (vertex)
